---
name: Independent reproduction report
about: Report an attempt to reproduce a SEED check or the case-study numbers on your own machine
title: "Reproduction: "
labels: ["reproduction"]
---

## Environment

OS, Python version, git version.

## Commit/SHA

The seed-protocol commit you ran against (full SHA).

## Command

The exact command(s) you ran, copied from the README Reproduce block or the case-study methods.

## Expected result

What the documentation says should happen (quote it).

## Observed result

What actually happened. Paste the command tail verbatim.

## Differences

Every place expected and observed disagree. "None" is a valid answer and is still worth filing.

## Evidence attached

Logs, receipts, or artifact files attached to this issue. A report without evidence is a claim, not a reproduction.
